branches.conclusion: The full university graduate inventory lists all Stillman School of Business on-campus and online awards as MBA or MS. Supply Chain Management is explicitly an MBA, not a doctoral programme.

The full eight-school graduate inventory lists Applied Physics and Engineering and Data Science and Engineering at MS level. Arts and Sciences doctorates listed are Chemistry and Molecular Bioscience; no Operations or IE engineering doctorate is listed.

sources.note: Entire current graduate programmes page read, including all eight schools, on-campus/online lists and exact listed award levels.

limitations: Bounded to the current central published graduate inventory; no historical programme absence or individual dissertation-topic census is claimed. Education leadership, health, nursing and psychology doctorates are not inferred to be Operations research programmes.
